title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 release and corporate adoption trend
summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 on September 1, 2026, as a top-tier model for programming and intellectual work, following Fable 5's June 9, 2026 launch. The model faced a temporary outage from June 12 due to U.S. export restrictions, restored globally July 1. Financial data indicates ~11% of corporate product expenses for tracked clients were allocated to Fable 5, though not reflective of total revenue. A trend shows companies preferring cheaper models when frontier quality doesn't impact business outcomes.
